name: Prolific PL2303 USB-serial adapter
summary: Older USB-serial chip found in many cheap cables. Counterfeit copies are common.

linux.notes: The pl2303 driver is built into Linux and works with genuine and most counterfeit chips.

win32.notes: Newer Prolific drivers refuse counterfeit or discontinued (PL2303HXA/XA) chips and Device Manager shows Code 10. If that happens the cable is the problem: replace it with an FTDI or CP210x cable.
